Cooperative SaaS

CoopX by Kopkad

A complete platform for cooperative societies — member wallets with personal account numbers, savings interest, contribution groups, loans, and an optional branded member portal. All in one place.

Member Savings Wallet

Every member gets a personal cooperative wallet with a 10-digit account number. Funded by bank transfer, earns interest at a rate you set.

Thrift Contribution

Run rotating contribution groups (ajo/esusu). Mark contributions, track schedules, and credit payouts directly to member wallets.

Loans

Issue and track member loans with interest, repayment schedules, and a manager-controlled approval flow.

Also on the menu: custom branding, an AI-generated public website, analytics, and a directory listing. Pick only the services you need and pay the sum of their monthly prices — every cooperative gets a free yourname.kopkad.ng subdomain at signup. See it all on .

Your Wealth Toolkit

Every tool works toward one goal:
growing your wealth

Track where your money goes, save before you spend, lock money for your goals, and learn the habits that build wealth, all in the app at app.kopkad.ng. Merchants and the agents who collect savings in the market run their business on the same app.

New · Kopkad Pay for Merchants

Your phone is the POS. Your customer doesn't need one.

Shops, market traders, and transport operators (keke, danfo, ride-hailing) take payment straight from a customer's Kopkad wallet. The customer reads out a one-time SMS code, so they don't need a smartphone, data, or a card.

Charge Customer

Enter the customer's phone number and amount, then type the code they read out. Paid instantly. ₦50,000 or more also needs their security answer.

To Kopkad

Send money instantly to any Kopkad user by phone number, and see their name before you confirm.

To Bank

Pay out to any Nigerian bank account, protected by your transaction PIN.

One account, one QR

Print your QR sticker once. Anyone can pay you by bank transfer to your permanent account number, with no app needed.

Locked Savings

Lock it. Grow it. Collect a fixed-rate return.

Choose an amount, pick a lock period, and see exactly how much you will earn at maturity — before committing a single naira. Up to 20% per annum, rate locked at creation.

Fixed interest rate

Rate locked at creation — never changes for the term.

Returns calculator

See your projected earnings at maturity before you commit.

Flexible or Fixed Lock

Add money any time, or lock a one-off sum. 3, 6, 9 or 12-month terms.

Wealth Builder

Split every income into Living, Savings and Give before you spend, keep to a daily budget, and climb from Seed to Harvest as your savings grow.

Financial Awareness

Short money lessons, from paying yourself first to spotting Ponzi schemes, each paired with the tool that puts it into practice.

Interest on Your Savings

No commission to save. Your balance earns interest, accrued daily and credited monthly — up to 20% p.a. depending on how much and how long you save. Rate can change with notice; 10% withholding tax applies.

Locked Savings

Lock money for 3–12 months at a fixed rate of up to 20% p.a., set at creation. Add money any time (Flexible Lock) or lock a one-off sum (Fixed Lock).

Expense Tracking

Log income and spending in seconds, see needs vs wants, and get your own income statement, cash flow and balance sheet.

Thrift (Ajo/Esusu) Groups

Join a field agent's thrift group with a link: fixed contributions, a rotating payout schedule, and every slot paid by card, transfer or wallet.

Wallet & Account Number

Complete KYC to get your own permanent 10-digit account number. Top up from any bank app, withdraw to your bank any time.

Merchant POS

Turn your phone into a POS with Kopkad Pay: charge customers, send to any Kopkad user, or pay out to any bank.

Pay Without Data

Pay a Kopkad merchant from your wallet by reading out a one-time SMS code. You don't need a smartphone, data or a card.

AJO Daily Card Marking

The core market savings workflow. Field agents register customers and mark their daily contributions in seconds, earning commission paid by Kopkad.

QR Physical Card System

Print QR savings cards for members. Scan with any smartphone to instantly open their account.

SMS & Email Notifications

Instant alerts when savings are marked, money lands in or leaves your wallet, or a payout is processed.

New · Wealth Builder

Save first, spend what's left, and watch your money grow

Most people save whatever is left at the end of the month, which is usually nothing. Wealth Builder turns that around: every income is split the moment it lands, so your savings come first and your spending has a clear limit.

Field Agents

Collect savings in your community and earn commission

Register customers, mark their daily savings, and get paid for it. Your commission is paid by Kopkad, never deducted from your customers' savings. From street-level ajo collectors to market traders, Kopkad works the way Nigerians actually save: in the community, face to face, one naira at a time.

Register customers

Sign up new customers on the spot, or share your referral code and link. Everyone you bring in joins your customer list.

Mark savings in seconds

Scan a customer's QR savings card and record their daily contribution. They get an alert straight away.

Earn commission, paid by Kopkad

Earn on the savings you mark, plus streak, milestone and referral bonuses. Kopkad pays you; your customers never pay commission.

Grow your rank

Climb the tiers from Starter to Champion, top the monthly leaderboard, and see which customers need a follow-up.

Run Thrift groups

Create ajo/esusu groups for the customers you register: fixed contributions, a rotating payout schedule, all tracked for you. You earn a share of the group commission.

Invite with one link

Share your group's join link. New people sign up straight into your group and onto your customer list.

Field agent tools come with every Kopkad merchant account.
